TRIGGERED_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: When Brain Maggot enters the battlefield, target opponent reveals his or her hand and you choose a nonland card from it. Exile that card until Brain Maggot leaves the battlefield.

Quand le Ver de cervelle arrive sur le champ de bataille, l’adversaire ciblé révèle sa main et vous y choisissez une carte non-terrain. Exilez cette carte jusqu’à ce que le Ver de cervelle quitte le champ de bataille.

Cuando la Larva cerebral entre al campo de batalla, el oponente objetivo muestra su mano y tú eliges de ahí una carta que no sea tierra. Exilia esa carta hasta que la Larva cerebral deje el campo de batalla.

Wenn die Hirnmade ins Spiel kommt, zeigt ein Gegner deiner Wahl die Karten auf seiner Hand offen vor, und du bestimmst eine Karte darunter, die kein Land ist. Schicke diese Karte ins Exil, bis die Hirnmade das Spiel verlässt.

Quando la Larva Cerebrale entra nel campo di battaglia, un avversario bersaglio rivela la sua mano e tu scegli una carta non terra da essa. Esilia quella carta finché la Larva Cerebrale non lascia il campo di battaglia.
脳蛆が戦場に出たとき、対戦相手１人を対象とする。そのプレイヤーは自分の手札を公開し、あなたはその中から土地でないカードを１枚選ぶ。脳蛆が戦場を離れるまで、そのカードを追放する。
뇌 구더기가 전장에 들어올 때, 상대를 목표로 정한다. 그 상대는 자신의 손을 공개하고 당신은 그 중 대지가 아닌 카드 하나를 선택한다. 뇌 구더기가 전장을 떠날 때까지 그 카드를 추방한다.

Когда Мозговой Червь выходит на поле битвы, целевой оппонент показывает свою руку, и вы выбираете из нее не являющуюся землей карту. Изгоните ту карту до тех пор, пока Мозговой Червь не покинет поле битвы.

Quando Verme Cerebral entra no campo de batalha, o oponente alvo revela a própria mão e você escolhe um card dela que não seja um terreno. Exile aquele card até Verme Cerebral deixar o campo de batalha.
当坏脑蛆进战场时，目标对手展示其手牌且你选择其中一张非地牌。放逐该牌，直到坏脑蛆离开战场为止。
當壞腦蛆進戰場時，目標對手展示其手牌且你選擇其中一張非地牌。放逐該牌，直到壞腦蛆離開戰場為止。
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:SetFilterType( FILTER_TYPE_PLAYERS ) filter:Add( FE_TEAM, OP_NOT, EffectController():GetTeam() )
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION:
local target_player = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_PlayerPtr(0) local numPlayers = MTG():GetNumberOfPlayers() if EffectSource() ~= nil then for i = 0, (numPlayers-1) do local player = MTG():GetNthPlayer(i)
if player ~= target_player and player ~= EffectController() then target_player:RevealHand(player) end end else
for i = 0, (numPlayers-1) do local player = MTG():GetNthPlayer(i)
if player ~= target_player then target_player:RevealHand(player) end end end

if EffectSource() ~= nil then local target_player = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_PlayerPtr(0) if target_player ~= nil then local filter = ClearFilter() filter:SetZone( ZONE_HAND, target_player ) filter:Add(FE_TYPE, OP_NOT, CARD_TYPE_LAND) EffectController():ChooseItem( "CARD_QUERY_CHOOSE_CARD_TO_EXILE", EffectDC():Make_Targets(1) ) end end

if EffectSource() ~= nil then if EffectDC():Get_Targets(1) ~= nil then local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(1):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then EffectDC():Get_Targets(1):Protect_CardPtr(0) target:Exile() end end end

if EffectSource() ~= nil then if EffectDC():Get_Targets(1) ~= nil then local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(1):Get_CardPtr(0) local source = EffectSource() if target ~= nil and source ~= nil then target:NailOnto(source) end end end
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.EXPIRY_ACTION: local cardToReturn = EffectDC():Get_Targets(1):Get_CardPtr(0) if cardToReturn ~= nil then cardToReturn:QueueZoneChange(ZONE_HAND, cardToReturn:GetOwner()) end
